note: Deployment is a horizontal formation (wiki Royal Hogs: 'Their deployment is in a horizontal formation'; history: 'their spawn formation was changed to be on a straight horizontal line'). The spacing is the touching-bodies rule, twice the game data export's collision radius 600; the export carries no formation field, and its summonRadius of 1 (a thousandth of a tile) stacked the four on the point, where the engine's collision resolution scattered them into a diamond with one hog a tile ahead and one behind.
